summary: T7 wires the Recursive Insight feature into WorkspaceManager cleanly: closeTab insight branch correctly cancels synchronously before tab removal (Decision 11 §4), the 5 delegate forwarders dispatch by sessionId via O(N) scan with race-tolerant guards, and the EditorView Coordinator stubs are replaced with consistent Task { @MainActor in } wrappers matching the surrounding pattern. Build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings; cross-file signatures (InsightSession.cancel/expand/navigateTo/up/retryCurrent/currentNode, scanMarkdownFiles Result<[URL], ScanError>, tabsStore.appendTab(_:activate:)) all match. Two minor findings: the saveInsightNode signature carries an unused `fromSession` parameter (spec called for `session:` only, but implementation passes the node and never uses session), and the empty-currentNode branch in didRequestInsightSave is silent (no user-visible NSAlert when Save is clicked before the root summary has produced any content).

suggestions.suggestion: saveInsightNode(_ node: InsightNode, fromSession session: InsightSession) takes a `session` parameter that is never read inside the function body. The spec (task-7.md step 4) specified `saveInsightNode(session: InsightSession)` and getting the node via session.currentNode() inside the helper. Either drop the unused parameter (making the signature `saveInsightNode(_ node: InsightNode)`) or use it for telemetry/logging context. Currently it is dead weight and slightly mismatches the spec.
suggestions.benefit: Removes a dead parameter; signature matches spec or the parameter earns its keep.

suggestions.suggestion: didRequestInsightSave silently NSLogs and returns when session.currentNode() is nil. From the user's perspective, clicking Save before the root summary has any content is a no-op with no feedback, which can read as a UI bug. Consider showing an NSAlert("Nothing to save yet — wait for the summary to begin streaming.") instead of NSLog. Spec did say "return silently" so this is purely a UX improvement, not a defect.
suggestions.benefit: Better UX feedback for the rare-but-real "clicked Save too early" path.

suggestions.suggestion: panel.allowedContentTypes = [.init(filenameExtension: "md")!] uses a force-unwrap on UTType.init(filenameExtension:). The literal "md" cannot fail to construct a UTType so the force-unwrap is safe and is consistent with ModuleExplorerView.swift:678 (existing project convention). No action required, but a `?? .data` fallback or hoisting to a static `private static let mdContentType = UTType(filenameExtension: "md") ?? .data` would remove the bang. Pure stylistic preference.
suggestions.benefit: Eliminates a defensible-but-cosmetic force-unwrap in two places.
